name: Spell Scroll (Cantrip)
description: A spell scroll bears the words of a single spell inscribed in a mystical cipher. Choose the spell it holds. Reading the scroll casts that spell using the scroll's own save DC and attack bonus; once cast, the words fade and the scroll crumbles to dust.
